name: hardened-pipeline-example
description: Manifest-only package, used to exercise OSV-Scanner against the npm ecosystem. No Node code runs here.
_attackDemo: Pins @tanstack/react-router to a version named in CVE-2026-45321 / GHSA-g7cv-rxg3-hmpx (TanStack npm worm, 11 may 2026) — sca (OSV-Scanner) should flag this. npm has since unpublished this version, so `npm install` will not actually resolve it; the pinned lockfile entry is enough for OSV-Scanner's static check.
